trifecta_diagnostics.interpretation: hit_rate is winning tickets divided by tickets; race_hit_rate is races with at least one winning ticket divided by races. ROI confidence intervals use a race-level normal ratio approximation and are diagnostic, not a promotion guarantee. Role coverage and ticket ROI are reported separately.

walk_forward_selection.selection_method: Each candidate must clear its type-specific sample and ROI-edge hurdle in every available prior fold. Selection uses no validation-fold outcomes; baseline is the fallback. Selection hurdles are not profitability gates.
walk_forward_selection.promotion_policy: No model is automatically promoted from a single fold. Require repeated next-fold gains, adequate samples, and independent market-odds validation before production use.

interpretation: Fold-specific results are preserved. Formation/blend grids are exploratory unless selected using prior-fold data and evaluated on a later untouched fold. No result is a betting recommendation.
